Usage: sink [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  🐙 Tools to manage projects.

  Use `sink COMMAND -h` for help on specific commands.

Options:
  -q, --quiet                  Hide rendered commands; -qq hides all output.
  -s, --suppress-commands      Alias for -q: do not display shell commands.
  --silent                     Alias for -qq: emit only the exit code.
  -v, --verbose                Increase diagnostics.
  --color [auto|always|never]  Color output: auto, always, or never.
  --config                     Print the discovered sink.yaml path and exit.
  --config-file FILE           Load this sink.yaml instead of discovering one.
  --completions                Write static bash completions and print their
                               path.
  --version                    Show the version and exit.
  -h, --help                   Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  action  Run a pre defined command on the server.
  check   Test server settings in config.
  db      Overwrite a db with a gzipped sql file.
  diff    Diff a local and remote file.
  file    Send files to and fro.
  info    View or edit the config file.
  misc    [Group] Misc stuff.
  ssh     SSH into a server.
